    output = ''
    pkg = vulnerability.pkg
    vuln = vulnerability.vulnerability
    cve = vulnerability.cve

        output += f"   Vulnerability ID: {vuln.get('id', 'N/A')}\n"
        output += "   This vulnerability is being ignored.\n"
        
        if vuln.get('ignored_reason'):
            output += f"   Reason: {vuln.get('ignored_reason')}\n"
        
        if vuln.get('ignored_expires'):
            expires = vuln.get('ignored_expires')
            if isinstance(expires, datetime):
                expires_str = expires.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')
            else:
                expires_str = str(expires)
            output = output.replace("This vulnerability is being ignored.\n", 
                                   f"This vulnerability is being ignored until {expires_str}. See your configurations.\n")
        
        output += "   For more information about this vulnerability, visit\n"
        output += f"   {vuln.get('more_info_url', 'N/A')}\n"
    else:
        is_pinned = is_pinned_requirement(pkg.requirements[0]) if pkg.requirements else True
        
        if is_pinned:
            output += f"-> Vulnerability found in {pkg.name} version {pkg.version}\n"
        else:
            output += f"-> Vulnerability may be present given that your {pkg.name} install specifier is\n"
            output += f"   {pkg.requirements[0]}\n"
        
        output += f"   Vulnerability ID: {vuln.get('id', 'N/A')}\n"
        output += f"   Affected spec: {vuln.get('affected_spec', '>0')}\n"
        output += f"   ADVISORY: \n"
        
        fixed_versions = vuln.get('fixed_versions', [])
        if fixed_versions:
            output += f"   Fixed versions: {', '.join(str(v) for v in fixed_versions)}\n"
        else:
            output += "   Fixed versions: No known fix\n"
        
        if cve:
            cvssv3 = cve.get('cvssv3', {})
            cvssv2 = cve.get('cvssv2', {})
            
            if cvssv3:
                severity = cvssv3.get('base_severity', 'UNKNOWN')
                base_score = cvssv3.get('base_score', 'N/A')
                impact_score = cvssv3.get('impact_score', 'N/A')
                vector = cvssv3.get('vector_string', '')
                output += f"   {vuln.get('advisory', 'bla')} is {severity} SEVERITY => CVSS v3, BASE SCORE {base_score}, IMPACT\n"
                output += f"   SCORE {impact_score}, VECTOR STRING {vector}\n"
            
            if cvssv2:
                base_score = cvssv2.get('base_score', 'N/A')
                impact_score = cvssv2.get('impact_score', 'N/A')
                vector = cvssv2.get('vector_string', '')
                output += f"   CVSS v2, BASE SCORE {base_score}, IMPACT SCORE {impact_score}, VECTOR STRING\n"
                output += f"   {vector}\n"
        
        if not is_pinned:
            output += "   This vulnerability is present in your install specifier range.\n"
            output += "   To learn more about reporting these, specifier range handling, and\n"
            output += "   options for scanning unpinned packages visit\n"
            output += "   https://docs.pyup.io/docs/safety-range-specs\n"
        
        output += "   For more information about this vulnerability, visit\n"
        output += f"   {vuln.get('more_info_url', 'N/A')}\n"
        output += f"   To ignore this vulnerability, use PyUp vulnerability id {vuln.get('id', 'N/A')} in\n"
        output += "   safety's ignore command-line argument or add the ignore to your safety\n"
        output += "   policy file.\n"
    
    return output

def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=

    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:

        text = click.style(text, fg=color)

        text = click.style(text, **styling)
    
    wrapped_lines = textwrap.wrap(text, width=columns - len(indent) - len(sub_indent))

        wrapped_lines = [text]

        wrapped_lines = wrapped_lines[:max_lines]

            result_lines.append(start_line_decorator + indent + line)
        else:
            result_lines.append(end_line_decorator + sub_indent + line)
    
    return '\n'.join(result_lines) + '\n'

    scanned_line = build_scanned_count_sentence(ctx.packages)
    brief_info.append(scanned_line)
    
    using_line = build_using_sentence(ctx.account, ctx.key, None)
    brief_info.append(using_line)
    
    return brief_info

def format_unpinned_vulnerabilities(unpinned_packages: Dict[str, List[Any]],
    columns: Optional[int]=None) ->List[str]:
    if columns is None:
        columns = get_terminal_size().columns
    
    result = []
    
    for pkg_name, vulns in unpinned_packages.items():
        result.append(f"Warning: {pkg_name} and {', '.join(unpinned_packages.keys())} are unpinned.")
    
    return result
